snapshot.title: Business Network Down — Ransomware Isolation

lines.msg: Service shutdown: MBW-CIS-01 (Customer Portal) unreachable via HTTP(S). All endpoints return 503. No response from port 443.
Service shutdown: MBW-AMI-01 (AMI Metering) unreachable via TCP 5000. No telemetry received since 05:30.
Security alert: MBW-NVR-01 (Video Recorder) logs show no access to Control Room entry point (CAM-01, CAM-02, CAM-03) since 05:30. Last access recorded: 05:29:48.

Network isolation triggered: MBW-FW-01 (Firewall) has blocked all inbound and outbound traffic from business LAN (10.73.x.x) to control network (10.72.x.x) per CISA and FBI incident response directive.
Business network status: DOWN. All systems on 10.73.x.x are unreachable. Email (mail.millbrook-oh.example), web portal, and AMI data paths are disabled.
Ransomware event confirmed: Malware signature CISA-2026-1024-RW01 detected on MBW-BKP-01 and propagated to MBW-LIMS-01. Full business network isolation enforced.
IT Director (Kevin Marsh) confirmed: All external access to business systems is now blocked. No remote access to control network via jump host (MBW-JUMP-01) permitted until further notice.
Control Room must use paper forms and landlines (555-031-2244) for all external communication. All customer contact and media reporting must be handled via manual process.
FW-R-22 (business-LAN exception) has been disabled. No further bypasses allowed.
All remote access paths are now blocked. Operations must rely on manual procedures and on-site verification.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the business network is fully isolated due to ransomware. The technical team must now operate without email, web, or AMI data. Watch for attempts to use MBW-JUMP-01 or unapproved remote access.
